evidence.note: Classified by vendor code AADSTS50011 (redirect URI mismatch)

evidence.actual: AADSTS50011: The redirect URI 'https://app.example.com/callback/' specified in the request does not match the redirect URIs configured for the application 'client-abc123'.

evidence.note: Differs only by a trailing slash
The registered value has no trailing slash

output.fix: Make the redirect_uri sent in the authorize request and the token request identical, character for character, to a URI registered on the client. Either send https://app.example.com/callback with no trailing slash, or register https://app.example.com/callback/ as an additional redirect URI. Don't use wildcard or loose matching. The PKCE S256 verifier matches the challenge and the public-client configuration is fine, so neither needs to change.

alternatives.why_not: The code_verifier matches the S256 code_challenge, so the PKCE check passes.
The public client with the authorization_code grant and S256 passes the client configuration check. The error is specific to the redirect URI.
